name: Robe of Useful Items

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Detach a patch
powers.text: Magic action: pull off one of the robe's cloth patches; it becomes the item it shows.

summary: Covered in cloth patches you can pull off to get the items they show (a dagger, a ladder, potions, a rowboat...).
text: Cloth patches of assorted shapes and colors cover this robe. While wearing it, you can spend a Magic action to pull off a patch, which turns into the object or creature it depicts; once the final patch is gone, the robe is just ordinary clothing. Every robe carries two each of these patches: Sack, Dagger, Steel Mirror, 10-foot Pole, Bullseye Lantern (fuelled and already burning) and Hempen Rope (a 50-foot coil). On top of those it has 4d4 random patches, each one of: a pit, a window, an iron door, a wooden ladder, a rowboat, a portable ram, a riding horse, two Mastiffs, four Potions of Healing, a level 1 to 3 Spell Scroll, a 500 GP silver coffer, a bag with 100 GP in it, or ten gems at 100 GP each.
